BUY-SELL AGREEMENT

This Buy-Sell Agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into as of March 2, 2026 (the "Effective Date") among Corbin Hardware, Inc., an Indiana corporation (the "Company"), and its shareholders, Lee Corbin and Ana Ruiz (each a "Shareholder").

1. Restriction on Transfer. No Shareholder may sell, give, pledge or otherwise transfer any shares of the Company except as this Agreement allows. A transfer made in violation of this Agreement is void.

2. Right of First Refusal. A Shareholder who receives a written offer from an outsider to buy shares must first offer them to the Company, and then to the other Shareholder, at the same price and on the same terms. The Company has 30 days, and the other Shareholder a further 30 days, to accept.

3. Death. On the death of a Shareholder, the Company shall purchase, and the estate of the deceased Shareholder shall sell, all of the shares the deceased Shareholder owned.

4. Disability, Retirement and Departure. If a Shareholder becomes disabled for twelve consecutive months, retires, or stops working for the Company for any other reason, the Company shall purchase, and that Shareholder shall sell, all of that Shareholder's shares.

5. Divorce and Bankruptcy. If shares would pass to a Shareholder's former spouse in a divorce, or to a trustee or creditor in a bankruptcy, the Company has the option to purchase those shares within 90 days after it learns of the event.

6. Purchase Price. The purchase price is the agreed value of the shares stated in the most recent Certificate of Agreed Value signed by both Shareholders. The Shareholders will sign a new certificate within 60 days after the end of each fiscal year. If no certificate was signed in the 24 months before the triggering event, the purchase price is the fair market value of the shares determined by an independent appraiser chosen by the Company's accountants, whose determination is final.

7. Funding. The Company will keep in force a policy of insurance on the life of each Shareholder in an amount at least equal to the agreed value of that Shareholder's shares, and will use the proceeds to pay the purchase price on that Shareholder's death. A purchase under Section 4 or 5 is funded from the Company's own funds.

8. Payment. On a purchase at death, the Company will pay the purchase price in cash at closing to the extent of the insurance proceeds. Any balance, and the price on any other purchase, is paid by a down payment of 20% at closing and the rest in 60 equal monthly installments under a promissory note bearing interest at 6% per year and secured by a pledge of the purchased shares.

9. Closing. The closing of a purchase takes place within 90 days after the triggering event, or 30 days after the purchase price is determined if later.

10. Legend. Each share certificate will bear a legend stating that the shares are subject to this Agreement.

11. General. This Agreement binds the Shareholders' heirs and personal representatives. It is governed by the laws of the State of Indiana, and the state courts located in Marion County, Indiana have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising under it. It may be amended only in a writing signed by the Company and both Shareholders.

CORBIN HARDWARE, INC.
